subject: Television & Streaming
title: Doctor Who: The Show That Regenerates
description: A fast breakdown of Doctor Who: The Show That Regenerates for builders.

hook.text: Doctor Who has aired since 1963. When the lead actor leaves, the character 'regenerates' into a new body.

buildup.text: The regeneration concept was invented out of necessity—the first actor got sick.

discovery.text: Fifteen actors have played the Doctor. Each brings a new interpretation.

twist.text: Jodie Whittaker became the first female Doctor in 2018.

climax.text: Doctor Who matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: The oldest sci-fi show on TV stays young by constantly dying.

quiz.question: Why is the regeneration concept considered Doctor Who's greatest creative strength?
options: It allows the show to recast its lead and reinvent itself across decades without losing continuity
